description: Use this when the guest wants a hotel, restaurant or attraction in a place, e.g. 'a quiet hotel near Chaweng Beach' or 'seafood in Bophut'. Results are sorted by distance when you give `near`. Don't use this when you already have a venue_id: call get_venue. Results come in pages of 10: when more_results is true, call again with the same arguments and cursor: next_cursor.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page of this same search

near.description: A place name, e.g. 'Chaweng Beach' or 'Fisherman's Village'. Sorts by distance from it.

party_size.description: Only venues with a room, table or ticket for this many people

query.description: Words to match in the name, area, city or description

radius_km.description: With near: only venues within this distance

type.description: hotel, restaurant or attraction; leave out for all

name: search_venues
title: Search venues
